messages:
jamie_cs: Quick ask  HelixPrime renewal next Tue. Need an SLA snapshot + evidence bundle: uptime (90d), P99 latency for /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings, daily availability by region, and a worked credit example if they hit partial latency degradation. Prefer CSVs and a one-page customer-friendly scorecard.

rishi_sre: Got it. Which model routes? Are we including fallback rates (when we route to smaller variants)?

jamie_cs: Primary: /v1/chat (gpt-rc) and /v1/embeddings (embed-1024). Include fallback counts and RPS.

tay_eng: I can export per-route SLOs from Grafana. Quick link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/ops/route-slo. Use the "Share > Export CSV" option. For P99 by region PromQL:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat"}[5m])) by (le,region))
```
Swap route tag for embeddings.

rishi_sre: I'll generate uptime (daily %) and P99 CSVs and include the query text. Note: for partial latency credit we weight minutes by region and route traffic. I'll add a worked example for HelixPrime using last 90d and their traffic mix.

bea_enablement: On onboarding, HelixPrime still has two open items in our tracker: webhook retry posture and dataset schema validation session. For the scorecard can I add an "Enablement status" panel with recommended next steps + suggested 30/60/90 day actions? I can draft copy.

jamie_cs: Yes please, include that and a note that we offered a 1:1 ops QBR earlier this quarter.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-5217 created and assigned to @rishi_sre and @tay_eng. Due date set: 2025-04-02.

tay_eng: Deliverables I'll produce: 1) CSV: daily uptime by region (last 90d) 2) CSV: P99 per-region per-route 3) CSV: fallback counts + RPS summary 4) README.md with queries and brief methodology. ETA 2025-04-01 EOD.

rishi_sre: I'll add the credit-calc worksheet (CSV + short worked example) and the relevant PromQLs. Also will include a short paragraph explaining rounding rules and edge-case handling (e.g., network blips < 1m).

bea_enablement: Drafting the enablement block now. Will include checklist status (completed/in progress), recommended sessions, and a quick enablement QR for the customer to book.

jamie_cs: Great. Once we have bundles, I'll assemble the scorecard PDF and run by Legal for the renewal append. If anyone spots an anomaly in the metrics, flag immediately. Thanks all :raised_hands:

tay_eng: Noted. FYI I saw a 45-min latency spike in eu-west earlier this window; I'll annotate it in the evidence bundle with traces and the root-cause note.

rishi_sre: Adding that to the worked credit calc so they can see how a single event would (or would not) translate to credits.

jamie_cs: Final ask  include a one-line "what this means" summary for execs (uptime %, weighted latency, and potential credit exposure). Keep it non-technical.

ops-bot: CS-5217 status updated to "In progress".
